visualReview.notes: Inspected all11 final portable/source-terrain frames including the1024×640 summary. Individual Padua Cathedral: broad unfinished brick east entrance with three recessed timber portals, two central oculi and stepped gable; long terracotta nave/aisle roofs; three tall rounded apses with long arched windows and upper round lights; two lower western chapels; pale many-sided crossing drum and lead-colored hemisphere/lantern/cross; mapped northwest square brick campanile. Apse pilasters were moved to the architectural bay boundaries to clear the windows, a concealed low tower slit was removed, and the nave cornice stopped behind the unfinished front. Fine profiles and vertical dimensions remain estimated.
